name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2026-06-27, at wavelengths from 1.03 to 4.91 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
